sample_unit: randomized female caregivers of unvaccinated daughters aged 12-18
unlisted_practices: Using an AI-driven chatbot for patient vaccine education compared with a government leaflet to improve HPV vaccine literacy and vaccination decisions

screen.reason: This is a randomized clinical trial comparing an AI chatbot to a standard government leaflet for HPV vaccine literacy among caregivers. It evaluates the tool's effectiveness directly rather than comparing different deployment practices or safeguards.
